| **`IXunitTestCollectionFactory`** | Informal/string-referenced | Must implement interface with `IXunitTestAssembly` ctor |
| **global.json** | VSTest runner | Removed (v3 uses built-in runner) |

I also added `AlphabeticalOrderer.cs` since v3's `typeof()` attribute requires the type to actually exist at compile time (unlike v2's string-based approach).
